propositions: The Anthropic cache breakpoint operates on whole system blocks, preventing multi-pass plan-bearing prefix reuse because Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier render through different paths with no shared plan-bearing prefix.

Moving the plan into a byte-identical shared prefix (single-sourced as prompts.shared_plan_prefix) enables within-pass cache reuse across verifier chunks and best-effort cross-run reuse within Anthropic's ~5-minute TTL.

The Pass-1 finder system prompt and both verifier stable prompt segments must each begin byte-for-byte with the shared plan prefix to enforce prefix cache reuse, with the exhaustiveness directive added to SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE for incremental-depth BLOCK loop coverage.
Per-run finding listings must remain in the USER message (base_instructions → instructions), never in the cached system prompt, to preserve the stable prefix boundary across verifier chunks.
The Pass-1 finder warm gate must measure shared_plan_prefix tokens (not plan alone) to match the bytes actually sent and cached, using a _prefix_tokens() helper against CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS.
